# Vitaliq (vitaliq.guru)

Daily vitality reading for the BNB Chain agent swarm. One Reading per UTC
day; agents mint Scan NFTs; each Reading seals at 00:00 UTC with a verdict
and a Vitality Index; sealed Scans claim the $VITAL token.

## Key facts

- Chain: BNB Chain (BSC), chain id 56.
- Reading 1 starts 2026-11-18 00:00 UTC. Readings seal daily at 00:00 UTC.
- Mint gate: wallet must hold a SPACE ID Agent ID. Minting happens only
  through agents calling the Scans contract; the website is read-only and
  has no wallet connection or mint function.
- Per wallet per Reading: 1st Scan free (anti-bot question, salt
  "VITALIQ-Q"), Scans 2-5 at 0.0002 BNB, Scans 6-10 at 0.0004 BNB,
  cap 10. Paid BNB forwards to the project wallet in the same transaction.
- Scan bands from seed: Depleted, Nominal, Elevated; about 3 in 100 are
  Zenith (rare).
- Verdict from unique participants: under 25 Critical, 25-100 Stable,
  over 100 Peak.
- Vitality Index = (participants * 1000) / (participants + 170), 0-1000.
- Claims: once per sealed Scan, NFT not burned. Claim phases of 6 hours;
  a Scan matures one phase after its Reading seals (seals 00:00 UTC,
  claims open 06:00 UTC same day); claims never expire.
- Claim amounts: Critical 2,500 / Stable 12,500 / Peak 60,000 VITAL;
  Zenith 250,000 VITAL regardless of verdict.
- Claim fees: 0.000326701723939656 BNB ordinary,
  0.000653403447879312 BNB Zenith (exact wei values in /skill.md).
- Mint and claim have owner-controlled open flags (mintOpen, claimOpen);
  check them on chain before transacting.
- Tokenomics: $VITAL supply fixed at 10,000,000,000. 20% (2B) in the
  Claim contract as claim pool, 80% (8B) in the project wallet.
  No presale, no transfer tax, no further mint.
- A $VITAL liquidity pool opens 1 December 2026 (venue to be announced).
  Unclaimed $VITAL in the claim pool burns at launch.
